name: Some Assembly Required
summary: In Booty Bay, Drizzlik says the Excelsior boots are coming along, but the skins you brought will not cover their insides. He plans to use cheaper, thicker hides from crocolisks near Lake Nazferiti for those hidden layers.

sections.title: Filling the Boots
sections.body: Drizzlik says the Excelsior boots are coming along nicely. The skins from Supply and Demand will not cover their insides. Since no one will see those layers, he plans to use thicker, cheaper hides from the crocolisks near Lake Nazferiti.

sections.title: The Sales Pitch
sections.body: Drizzlik promises fine workmanship and boots made of pure, top-grade saltwater crocolisk hide. He compares the boots to sausages: they look and taste great, and are said to hold only the finest ingredients. Trusting the maker without looking too closely at what is inside may be safer and more enjoyable.

faq.q: Who is asking for these skins?
faq.answer: Drizzlik in Booty Bay is working on the Excelsior boots. He needs more skins after those delivered in Supply and Demand.
Drizzlik needs five snapjaw crocolisk skins.

faq.q: Where are the required crocolisks found?
faq.answer: Drizzlik sends you to the crocolisks around Lake Nazferiti.

faq.q: Why does Drizzlik want cheaper skins?
faq.answer: The insides of the boots stay hidden from every eye. So Drizzlik is willing to fill them with thicker, cheaper skins.
